episode.subject: giant sequoia
episode.title: The wrong trunk
episode.body: A cone fell from me onto the path. The man beneath it looked up and complained to the tree beside me. I was enjoying the mistake until he stroked her bark to apologize.

rootReview: Exact960x720 photo opened. Clear person leaning with both arms against broad giant-sequoia bark; neighboring trunks and forest floor visible. Cone drop, complaint, apology and sequence remain invented. No actual photographed motive, name or age assigned.
